name: sa-chaos-desktop
description: SA-CHAOS Desktop Application with Config Dashboard and Server

scripts.obfuscate: rimraf obfuscated-main && javascript-obfuscator ./main --output ./obfuscated-main --compact true --control-flow-flattening true --control-flow-flattening-threshold 0.75 --dead-code-injection true --dead-code-injection-threshold 0.4 --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --rename-globals true --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4 --string-array-threshold 0.75 --transform-object-keys true --unicode-escape-sequence true --target node
scripts.prebuild:win: npm run obfuscate && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('main/splash.html', 'obfuscated-main/splash.html'); require('fs').writeFileSync('obfuscated-main/build-time.txt', new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta', hour12: false }) + ' WIB')"

author: AthallahDzaki
